details: The default governed layout creates one bottom Activity pane instead of three recon panes.
Every nonzero LOOP_RECON_PANES value normalizes to one pane; zero remains an explicit opt-out.
The Activity pane includes Routes, Tools, and Results headers even in a four-row viewport.
Legacy direct recon indices two and three still render Tools and Results for compatibility.
The Activity pane receives 25 percent height and spans the full main-agent width.
Main-agent and helper TOTAL, INPUT, CACHE, and OUTPUT token fields share exact character boundaries.
Main-agent TEXT, THINK, and TOOL and helper CALLS and TOOLS use fixed numeric subcolumns.
Effort, mode, multiplier, context percentage, compaction, limits, reset, cost, and rate are fixed-width subcolumns.
Session-first then weekly quota semantics and weekly-only Codex indentation remain unchanged.
